flagged.item: OLBG lists 19:37 for both Oct 21 NHL games; the NHL lists 7:30 PM EDT.
flagged.detail: The two OLBG event pages show 19:37 without a stated time zone. The NHL schedule and both gamecenters show 7:30 PM EDT. The site publishes the league time and does not convert or reconcile OLBG's figure.

flagged.item: OLBG's default tips page surfaces only one eligible-sport event.
flagged.detail: On the snapshot the default page listed football, Gaelic football, horse racing, handball and snooker alongside a single eligible NBA event (MIL @ WAS). No complete eligible-sport OLBG inventory could be reconstructed from that page, so league schedules are used as the fixture inventory and OLBG links are attached only where an event page was actually found.

flagged.item: NHL gamecenter headers and the NHL statistics API disagree with the standings table on games played.
flagged.detail: Carolina's gamecenter shows 7-2-1 while the standings table shows 8-2-1 over 11 games; the gamecenter's own GF/GP of 3.82 equals 42/11, so the rates match the standings while the header does not. The NHL statistics API returns 10 games played and 36 goals for Carolina. All three are NHL.com properties. The build uses the standings table, which is timestamped and internally consistent.

flagged.item: Every NBA line is a baseline; no current-season form exists.
flagged.detail: NBA.com's standings show the 2026-27 season is 0-1 games old, so the engine rates every club league-average and applies a 2.5-point home edge. No total is originated because no verified league scoring baseline is loaded. These are opening-style lines, not informed prices, and every NBA pick is labelled low confidence.

flagged.item: MLB reports zero games for Oct 21 2026.
flagged.detail: The official MLB stats API returns totalGames 0 for the date. No baseball row is published. This is not evidence that the season has ended, only that no game is scheduled that day.

flagged.item: Eleven eligible sports were not verified in this session.
flagged.detail: Tennis, cricket, rugby union, rugby league, snooker, darts, handball, volleyball, golf, motor racing and greyhounds were not cross-checked against an official schedule. No fixtures, lines or picks are published for them. They are listed on the Coverage page with their OLBG sport index and marked unverified rather than estimated.

flagged.item: Venue is blank where the fetched source did not state it.
flagged.detail: Venue is published only for fixtures whose official page named the arena. Blank cells are deliberate and unverified, not missing data that was inferred.

flagged.item: No official bulk source for 2025-26 NBA records was retrieved.
flagged.detail: The NBA standings page renders the current season regardless of the season parameter supplied, and per-game preview text was the only place prior-season records appeared. Rather than assemble ratings from a partial set of preview pages, no prior-season rating is used at all.
